answer: Charge sybils at the point of influence. Before an agent can attest or grade, it must lock a jade collateral at exactly one identity vertex — the custody key that signs its work — and keep that lock through a vesting window. Detected multi-account rings are slashed across every linked vertex, not just the one that tripped the detector. A scheduled summit audit then compares attestation volume to bond age and unique work proofs; fabricating a voting majority means buying many frozen jade stakes and risking a total wipeout, so the expected cost outruns the payout.
